shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'ls -la; cat package.json; cat src/App.tsx; cat src/main.tsx; cat tsconfig.json; cat vite.config.ts; find .. -name AGENTS.md -print'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/uikit version dist-tags --json; git status --short; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs | head -35'

/bin/bash -lc 'cat index.html; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Provider; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts; npm ls --depth=0'

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg '(provider|Provider|INDEX.md|theming.md|ControlProps)' | head -45; rg -n 'Provider|useTheme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -135; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/Provider.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.js"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"for (const name of ['playwright', '@playwright/test', 'puppeteer', 'jsdom']) { try { console.log(name + ': ' + import.meta.resolve(name)); } catch {} }\"; ls /tmp; git diff --stat; git diff -- src/App.tsx src/main.tsx package.json index.html; rg -n -- '--g-border-radius-xl|--g-color-base-float' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -5"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check; git status --short; rg -n '\"@gravity-ui/uikit\"|\"node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit\"|\"version\": \"8.0.0\"' package.json package-lock.json"
